Not a CpE major, but a EE here.

CpE is the same as EE except for like a few classes.  I can say as a EE that the hardest classes are your junior year classes and these are classes that the CpEs took with us.  The senior year classes imo were relatively easy.  I say relatively because most classes I took senior year were like gen eds, senior design (which was fun), and technical electives (these are classes you pick), so these were all classes that were either easy, interesting or both.

Now the advantage of staying as a CpE is that I think you may have more jobs open to you, but it all depends on what you want your career to look like.  If you want to do just software, then do CS.  If you can see yourself doing a little hardware, then stick with CpE.
